# nebula_ca (Resource)

A self-signed Nebula CA certificate whose private key is a version of an `ed25519` transit key. Creating it needs `read` on `<mount>/keys/<key_name>` and `update` on `<mount>/sign/<key_name>`. Reading and deleting it never call OpenBao/Vault; deleting only removes it from state. Any change to an input replaces the certificate, except `early_renewal_hours`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The transit key must exist: bao write transit/keys/nebula-ca type=ed25519 exportable=false
resource "nebula_ca" "mesh" {
  key_name    = "nebula-ca"
  key_version = 1

  name     = "example mesh CA"
  groups   = ["lighthouse", "servers", "laptops"]
  networks = ["10.99.0.0/16"]
  duration = "17520h" # two years

  # Plan a new CA 60 days before expiry.
  early_renewal_hours = 1440
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key_name` (String) Name of the `ed25519` transit key that holds the CA private key.
- `key_version` (Number) Version of the transit key to sign with. Pinned on purpose: rotating the transit key creates a new CA, which must be rolled out with a CA bundle (see the README).
- `name` (String) Name of the certificate.

### Optional

- `duration` (String) Validity as a Go duration, e.g. `8760h`. Defaults to `8760h` (one year). Conflicts with `not_after`.
- `early_renewal_hours` (Number) Plan a replacement this many hours before `not_after`. The check runs during plan, so renewal happens on the first apply inside the window. Defaults to `0` (replace once expired). Changing it alone does not replace the certificate.
- `groups` (List of String) Groups the CA may issue. Empty means any group.
- `networks` (List of String) Networks (CIDR) host certificates may use. Empty means any.
- `not_after` (String) Expiry as an RFC 3339 timestamp with whole seconds. If not set, computed from `duration`.
- `unsafe_networks` (List of String) Unsafe networks (CIDR) host certificates may route. Empty means any.
- `version` (Number) Nebula certificate format version, `1` or `2`. Defaults to `2`. Version 2 needs Nebula 1.10 or newer.

### Read-Only

- `cert_pem` (String) The certificate in Nebula PEM format.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate, as shown by `nebula-cert print`.
- `id` (String) The certificate fingerprint.
- `not_before` (String) Start of validity (RFC 3339).
- `public_key_pem` (String) The CA's Ed25519 public key (the transit key version's public key) in Nebula PEM format.
- `ready_for_renewal` (Boolean) True when the certificate is expired or within `early_renewal_hours` of expiry; the plan then replaces it.
